senses.gloss:
अप्युत ind. Also, indeed.
 E. अपि, and उत or.

आप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
 1. Watery, consisting of water, as froth, &c.
 2.
Obtainable, to be obtained.
 n. (-प्यं) A plant, a kind of costus. E.
अप् water, यञ् affix; or आप to get, यत् aff.

आप्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
 1. Stout, robust.
 2. Fat.
 E. आङ् before स्फाय to
grow, क्त aff.

आप्यायन n. (-नं)
 1. Pleasing, satisfying.
 2. Satiety, satisfaction.
 3. Ad-
vancing.
 4. Corpulency, growing or being fat or stout.
 E. आङ् be-
fore स्फाय to increase, ल्युट् aff.

आप्यायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Pleased.
 2. Satisfied.
 3. Increased, improv-
ed.
 4. Stout, fat.
 E. आङ् before स्फाय to increase, क्त aff.
